highlights.title: A habit, found in three rounds
commentary: Rock Solid plays rock every round. Frequentists counts what it sees and answers the favourite.
By round 4 it was playing paper, and it barely stopped.

highlights.title: Two bots, one cycle
commentary: After a draw, Win-Stay plays whatever beats the opponent's last move.
That is exactly the next step of Round Robin's cycle, so they draw, round after round, until noise breaks it.

highlights.title: Predicting the predictor
commentary: Second Guessers always plays what beats the move that would beat its own last one.
That rule is a pattern too, and Markov Chains learnt it within a few rounds.

highlights.title: The best reader in the field
commentary: Iocaine Powder runs four predictors at once and follows whichever is working.
Last Word only ever beats the opponent's last move, and one of the four predictors catches that straight away.
